exp.1.summary: I provide end-to-end IT support with a proactive, solution-oriented approach, focusing on resolving technical issues quickly and permanently, keeping systems running without interruption, and maintaining service continuity. I contribute to operational efficiency through process improvement, cross-department coordination, technical project management, IT asset lifecycle management, and vendor management.
exp.2.summary: I provided end-to-end IT support to approximately 4,700 employees across corporate offices, call centers, and manufacturing facilities. I helped maintain operational continuity through fast troubleshooting, infrastructure management, and VIP user support. I managed the lifecycle of IT assets and improved security and access processes. I also worked on infrastructure projects, technical documentation, and initiatives that supported the reliable operation of production systems.
exp.3.summary: I provided dedicated IT support to stock exchange and trading floor staff. In high-volume financial environments, I focused on maintaining the availability and performance of critical workstations and specialized trading equipment. I quickly identified hardware failures and worked with IT teams on proactive maintenance, system upgrades, change management, and business continuity, helping to minimize service disruptions.
